description: This file implements an HTTP-based smart turn analyzer class for remote machine learning inference, handling serialization of audio data, HTTP communication, error handling, and prediction logic.

classes.name: HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that performs smart turn analysis by sending audio data to a remote ML inference service over HTTP, including serialization, request handling, and error recovery.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer with URL, session, headers, and additional parameters.

methods.name: _serialize_array
methods.description: Serializes a NumPy audio array into bytes for HTTP transmission.

methods.name: _send_raw_request
methods.description: Sends serialized audio data to the remote HTTP endpoint and processes the response.

methods.name: _predict_endpoint
methods.description: Performs prediction by serializing the audio array and making an asynchronous HTTP request, with error handling.
